title: Uses permitted in C1 and C2 Districts
previewText:
Within C1 and C2 Districts, the underlying use provisions shall apply, except that:

uses listed under Use Group IV(B) shall not be permitted; and uses listed under Use Group X with a size limitation, as denoted with an “S” in the Use Group table set forth in Section 32-20 (Use Group X – Production Uses), inclusive, shall not exceed 10,000 square feet of floor area per establishment.
